rootCause: BH Token (BlackHole token) suffered an attack. The exploiter (0xFDb) gained 1.2 M USDT. Funds are being swapped for BNB and deposited into Tornado Cash. Contract Address: 0xCC61CC9F2632314c9d452acA79104DDf680952b5. Exploiter Address: 0xFDbfcEEa1de360364084a6F37C9cdb7AaeA63464.

descriptions.text: BH Token (BlackHole token) suffered an attack. The exploiter (0xFDb) gained 1.2 M USDT. Funds are being swapped for BNB and deposited into Tornado Cash. Contract Address: 0xCC61CC9F2632314c9d452acA79104DDf680952b5. Exploiter Address: 0xFDbfcEEa1de360364084a6F37C9cdb7AaeA63464.

On 11 October 2023, BlackHole Token (BH) was exploited on BNB Chain through flashloan-driven price manipulation of the BH/USDT PancakeSwap pool. The attacker extracted approximately $1.27 million by distorting pool reserves and exploiting manipulated liquidity removal ratios. No on-chain recovery or confirmed patch appears in any available records. The BlackHole Token contracts and liquidity pool pricing relied directly on the manipulable spot reserve ratio of the BH/USDT pair. The attacker used a flashloan to artificially alter the pool's reserve balance, accelerating slippage and enabling abnormal liquidity withdrawal at inflated ratios, ultimately extracting outsized profit.…
